_doc: A tin cup (PropModels' cup: tinplate on a strap handle, a loose rigid prop: LooseProp), ~150 g, a splash of whiskey in it. Knocked off its table by a ball or a blast it rolls; a ball holes it through both sides (the tin costs a ball what ~1 mm of wood would); landing hard (3 m/s) or kicked it dents; it never breaks or burns.
